from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
import json

class Hou_Mcp_Remote_Worker(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_remote_worker"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("action",            "string", widget_type="text", default="list")
        self.add_input("worker_id",         "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_input("worker_name",       "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_input("capabilities_json", "string", widget_type="text", default="[]")
        self.add_input("max_load",          "int",    widget_type="int",  default=4)
        self.add_input("endpoint",          "string", widget_type="text", default="local://")
        self.add_output("ok",           "bool")
        self.add_output("worker_id",    "string")
        self.add_output("workers",      "list")
        self.add_output("status",       "string")
        self.add_output("current_load", "int")
        self.add_output("report_json",  "string")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        from src.runtime.worker_runtime import get_worker_runtime
        wr     = get_worker_runtime()
        action = str(inputs.get("action", "list")).strip().lower()
        _empty = {
            "exec_out": True, "ok": False, "worker_id": "",
            "workers": [], "status": "", "current_load": 0, "report_json": "{}"
        }

        try:
            caps_raw = inputs.get("capabilities_json") or "[]"
            try:
                caps = json.loads(caps_raw)
            except Exception:
                caps = []

            if action == "register":
                name = str(inputs.get("worker_name", "")).strip()
                if not name:
                    _empty["status"] = "error: worker_name required"
                    return _empty
                wid = wr.register_worker(
                    name=name,
                    capabilities=caps,
                    endpoint=str(inputs.get("endpoint", "local://")),
                    max_load=int(inputs.get("max_load", 4)),
                )
                w = wr.get_worker(wid)
                return {
                    "exec_out": True, "ok": True, "worker_id": wid,
                    "workers": [w], "status": "registered",
                    "current_load": 0,
                    "report_json": json.dumps({"action": "register", "worker_id": wid}),
                }

            elif action == "heartbeat":
                wid = str(inputs.get("worker_id", "")).strip()
                ok  = wr.update_heartbeat(wid)
                w   = wr.get_worker(wid) or {}
                return {
                    "exec_out": True, "ok": ok, "worker_id": wid,
                    "workers": [w] if w else [],
                    "status": "heartbeat_ok" if ok else "not_found",
                    "current_load": w.get("current_load", 0),
                    "report_json": json.dumps({"action": "heartbeat", "ok": ok}),
                }

            elif action == "acquire":
                wid = wr.acquire_worker(required_capabilities=caps)
                w   = wr.get_worker(wid) if wid else None
                return {
                    "exec_out": True, "ok": wid is not None, "worker_id": wid or "",
                    "workers": [w] if w else [], "status": "acquired" if wid else "no_worker",
                    "current_load": w.get("current_load", 0) if w else 0,
                    "report_json": json.dumps({"action": "acquire", "worker_id": wid}),
                }

            elif action == "release":
                wid = str(inputs.get("worker_id", "")).strip()
                ok  = wr.release_worker(wid)
                w   = wr.get_worker(wid) or {}
                return {
                    "exec_out": True, "ok": ok, "worker_id": wid,
                    "workers": [w] if w else [], "status": "released" if ok else "not_found",
                    "current_load": w.get("current_load", 0),
                    "report_json": json.dumps({"action": "release", "ok": ok}),
                }

            elif action == "deregister":
                wid = str(inputs.get("worker_id", "")).strip()
                ok  = wr.deregister_worker(wid)
                return {
                    "exec_out": True, "ok": ok, "worker_id": wid,
                    "workers": wr.list_workers(), "status": "deregistered" if ok else "not_found",
                    "current_load": 0,
                    "report_json": json.dumps({"action": "deregister", "ok": ok}),
                }

            elif action == "status":
                wid = str(inputs.get("worker_id", "")).strip()
                w   = wr.get_worker(wid)
                return {
                    "exec_out": True, "ok": w is not None, "worker_id": wid,
                    "workers": [w] if w else [], "status": w.get("status", "not_found") if w else "not_found",
                    "current_load": w.get("current_load", 0) if w else 0,
                    "report_json": json.dumps(w or {"error": "not_found"}),
                }

            else:  # list
                workers = wr.list_workers()
                return {
                    "exec_out": True, "ok": True, "worker_id": "",
                    "workers": workers, "status": f"{len(workers)} workers",
                    "current_load": sum(w.get("current_load", 0) for w in workers),
                    "report_json": json.dumps({"count": len(workers), "stats": wr.stats()}),
                }

        except Exception as exc:
            _empty["status"] = f"error: {exc}"
            _empty["report_json"] = json.dumps({"error": str(exc)})
            return _empty

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Remote_Worker
